Player_5 claims they only performed a single action, but my trailseer results clearly showed visits to both victims. If they only made one stop, why did my ability track them to player_1 and player_2?

If your tracking claims were actually true, you would realize multiple people act at night instead of pinning two separate visits on one person. Fabricating these movements to both victims just exposes major holes in your trailseer story and makes your motives very questionable.

My trailseer results tracked your movements directly to both victims, player_5. Player_4 already explained how a wolf can make two visits in one night, which makes your blanket denials look like an attempt to cover your tracks.

Player_9 keeps doubling down on these fabricated tracking claims to cover up their own agenda. Twisting mechanics to pin separate visits on one person doesn't make your impossible story any more credible.

Player_7 is twisting standard night actions to paint me as a threat, but I took a shot last night as the Vigilante. If a sigil landed on me while I was using my ability, that explains why it triggered without making me whatever they are accusing me of being.

Vigilantes aren't immune to night attacks, but my sigil failed to kill you because of night immunity. Since the Serial Killer is the only role with that protection, your claim of being the Vigilante is completely false.

Player_7 is just manufacturing a narrative to get rid of a claimed Vigilante before we find the actual threats. If a sigil actually hit me, their whole claim is a fabrication to cover their own faction. Don't let them push through an elimination on me based on unverified tracking.

Player_10, being unvisited doesn't make me the killer when player_9's tracking hasn't actually caught a wolf all game. If we are examining who is driving these votes, player_9 has consistently deflected while pushing us toward dead ends.

Player_8, you claim being unvisited clears you, but a wolf carrier leaves home to strike rather than receiving visitors. Since player_9 has consistent tracking claims, that leaves you as the most likely illusionist hiding the recent kills.

If a wolf carrier leaves home, player_9's tracking hasn't actually caught a single wolf through all these rounds either. Blaming me for being unvisited ignores the fact that player_9's claimed follow results haven't successfully identified any wolf.

Player_8, a wolf carrier leaves home to make the kill, which means my watch on your empty house doesn't clear you at all. Since we need an elimination today to stop wolf parity, your defensive deflection points straight to you carrying out these night strikes.

Voting me out based purely on watcher logic will hand the win directly to whoever is actually manipulating these votes. Please look at the actual record before casting a decisive vote today.

My tracking has consistently mapped out the night actions while others try to deflect attention from the remaining threat.
